parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of the report window (RFC 3339), after `from`, at most 92 days later.

parameters.name: thresholdMinutes
parameters.description: A departed trailer whose dwell exceeds this many minutes counts as detention exposure. Defaults to 120 (the two hour norm). Anything else than an integer from 1 to 10080 is a 400 `invalid-threshold-minutes`.
